scope: complete CPU OutputParser; incremental search cursor for raw tool parameters
method: 7 interleaved A/B/A triplets; B median vs geometric mean of A medians; reject >3% A drift
interpretation: Small, unstable differences around 1%-2% are treated as noise, not as a confidence interval.
notes: Production changes only raw-parameter cursor state in OutputParser; one regression test added.
The cursor advances only after no complete candidate and at least 12 codepoints searched, retaining 11 codepoints.
An undecided follower retains the existing search start, so its candidate cannot be skipped.
The consumed-value offset is unchanged and preserves the entire JSON value until it can be decoded.
No dependency, regex, native source/binary, model configuration or production engine executable changes.
